senses.why: A side piece spreading out from a body looks like a wing on a bird, so architecture borrowed the word.
senses.whyCN: 从主体伸出去的侧片很像鸟翼，于是建筑也借用了这个词。

senses.title: A group inside a party
senses.definition: one of the groups inside a political party or a movement, holding a distinct view
senses.definitionCN: 政党或运动内部持有不同主张的一组人
senses.example: The moderate wing of the party opposed the new tax.
senses.exampleCN: 党内的温和派反对这项新税。
senses.why: A party spreads out on both sides like a pair of wings, and each side got a name of its own.
senses.whyCN: 党派像一对翅膀分向两侧展开，每一侧都得到了自己的名字。

intro.en: Wing is an old Germanic word for the flying limb, related to the verb that meant to flutter; the Norse form had a soft g that eventually fell silent.
intro.cn: wing 是日耳曼语中表示飞行肢体的老词，与意为「扑翅」的动词同源；诺斯语形式的软 g 后来不发音了。

items.en: A common Germanic root named the wing and the act of flapping it.
items.cn: 一个共同的日耳曼词根既指翅膀，也指扑动它的动作。

items.en: The Norse vængr carried a soft g, and this form entered English lands in the north.
items.cn: 诺斯语 vængr 带有软 g，这一形式进入了北方的英格兰地区。

items.en: The native word for wing was feþera, feather, which survived only in the sense of plumage.
items.cn: 古英语本土表示翅膀的词是 feþera（羽毛），只在羽饰义上存活下来。

items.en: The Norse word became the standard wing, and buildings took it for their side parts.
items.cn: 诺斯语词成为标准的 wing，建筑也借它表示侧部。

items.en: Aviation made wing mean the lifting surface, and politics gave each faction a wing of its own.
items.cn: 航空时代让 wing 指升力面，政治又让每个派别各自拥有一翼。

note.en: The first group collects look-alike short words, the second body parts and surfaces with a similar job.
note.cn: 第一组收形近短词，第二组收职司相似的部位与面。

entries.definition: To come out first in a contest.
To complain in a tiresome way.
To move back and forth from a fixed point.
A male ruler of a country.
One of the light plates covering a bird.
A thin limb a fish uses to steer.
The side of an animal or an army.

normalIntro.en: Wing is short and ends in a soft -ng, the sound of something spreading out.
normalIntro.cn: wing 很短，收在软的 -ng 上，像东西展开时的声音。

normal.en: The -ng ending hums, like air under a lifted feather.
normal.cn: 结尾的 -ng 嗡嗡地响，像羽毛下钻过的空气。

normal.en: Win plus g: you win with a pair of wings, not a single one.
normal.cn: win 加一个 g：靠一对翅膀才赢，单只不够。

normal.en: Swing contains wing, and a wing swings the air.
normal.cn: swing 里含着 wing，翅膀正是把空气拨开的那个东西。

normal.en: A plane wing and a palace wing share the same simple picture: a part sticking out sideways.
normal.cn: 机翼与宫殿侧翼共享同一个简单形象：向侧面伸出去的一块。

normal.en: Under someone's wing is to be sheltered, as chicks under a folded one.
normal.cn: be under someone's wing 是被庇护，就像雏鸟躲在收拢的翼下。

abstract.en: Two shapes unfolding to the full width at once.
abstract.cn: 两个形状在同一瞬间展开到最宽。

abstract.en: The moment after leaving a railing, when no ground is touched.
abstract.cn: 离开栏杆之后、还没碰上任何地面的那一刻。

abstract.en: A shadow passing over a path with no sound attached.
abstract.cn: 一道影子从小径上掠过，却没有附带任何声音。

examples.en: A moth with pale wings knocked against the lamp.
examples.cn: 一只浅色翅膀的蛾子撞在灯上。

examples.en: She was taken under the wing of an older musician.
examples.cn: 她被一位年长的音乐家收在门下。

examples.en: The hospital added a new wing last year.
examples.cn: 医院去年加建了一座侧楼。

dict_mnemonic.text: wing 结尾的 -ng 像翅膀震动时的嗡声。

root: 日耳曼语词根（翼、扑翅）→ 古诺斯语 vængr → 中古英语 winge → wing；同族有 winged、wingless。

sensesIntro.en: The word begins as a bird's limb, extends to machines of flight, to the sides of buildings, then to the sides of a party.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从鸟的肢体开始，扩展到飞行机械，再到建筑的侧部，最后到党派的阵营。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two feathered shapes unfolded at the moment of take-off.
core.cn: 核心意象：起飞一瞬完全展开的两片羽翼。

branches.en: The bird branch: a white bird rising over the river.
branches.cn: 鸟类分支：白鸟从河面升起。

branches.en: The flying machine branch: ice on the wings of an aircraft.
branches.cn: 飞行器分支：机翼上的冰。

branches.en: The building branch: the east wing of a palace.
branches.cn: 建筑分支：宫殿的东侧翼。

branches.en: The political branch: the moderate wing of a party.
branches.cn: 政治分支：党内的温和派。

branches.en: The shape branch: everything is a part that spreads sideways.
branches.cn: 形状分支：一切都成了向侧面铺开的部分。

intro.en: Wing is a bare Germanic noun that takes common endings and makes compounds such as wingless and wingman.
intro.cn: wing 是光秃的日耳曼名词，能接常见词尾，也能构成 wingless、wingman 这类复合词。

latinIntro.en: The stem has no Latin source; ala, the Latin word for wing, appears only in scientific and borrowed shapes.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词干没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语的 ala（翼）只出现在科学与借入的形式里。

items.example: It is the plain noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 它既是朴素的动词也是名词。

items.example: The side sense moved into politics.
The picture of chicks under feathers.
items.exampleCN: 雏鸟躲在羽毛下的画面。

definition_zh: 冬天；冬季；寒冷的时期；（引申）低谷期
definition_en: the coldest season of the year, and by extension a cold or unproductive period of life or business
core_image: 光秃的树枝上挂着薄冰，地上只剩一层硬硬的霜，呼出的气白成一团
scene: 河面结了薄冰，光秃的树枝上挂着霜，人一出门呼出的气就白成一团。Snow lay on the fields all winter long.
sceneCN: 这里 winter 是「冬天」（第 1 个义项：一年中最冷的季节）；句意为整个冬天田野上都覆着雪。结冰的河面和树上那层霜，就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: The cold season
senses.definition: the season between autumn and spring, the coldest part of the year, with short days
senses.definitionCN: 秋冬之间的季节，一年中最冷、白昼最短的时期
senses.example: Snow lay on the fields all winter long.
senses.exampleCN: 整个冬天田野上都覆着雪。
senses.why: The oldest meaning is simply the wet or cold season, named long before calendars were fixed.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思就是寒冷潮湿的季节，早在历法确定之前就已得名。

senses.title: A time of cold weather
senses.definition: very cold weather, or a period when such weather lasts unusually long
senses.definitionCN: 极冷的天气，或这类天气持续得特别长的一段时间
senses.example: The farm lost half its sheep in that terrible winter.
senses.exampleCN: 那个可怕的寒季，农场损失了一半的羊。
senses.why: Because the season is defined by its cold, the word can stand for the cold itself.
senses.whyCN: 既然这个季节以寒冷为标志，这个词也能直接代指寒冷本身。

senses.title: A fallow or hard period
senses.definition: a period when activity, growth or fortune is low, as in the winter of a business or a life
senses.definitionCN: 活力、增长或运势低落的时期，如生意或人生的冬天
senses.example: The company survived the winter of the crisis and grew again.
senses.exampleCN: 公司熬过了危机的冬天，又重新生长。
senses.why: Bare trees and empty fields look like loss, so people use the season for any time of decline.
senses.whyCN: 光秃的树与空空的田野看起来像失去，于是人们用这个季节指任何衰退的时期。

intro.en: Winter is a common Germanic season word built on the same root as wet and wind, naming the wet or snowy half of the year.
intro.cn: winter 是日耳曼语共有的季节词，与 wet、wind 同根，命名一年中潮湿多雪的那一半。

items.en: A root with the sense of wet or white time gave the peoples of the north a name for the cold season.
items.cn: 一个带有潮湿、洁白意味的词根，给了北方各族命名寒冷季节的词。

items.en: winter was both a noun and a verb, and the year was often counted in winters.
items.cn: winter 既是名词也是动词，人们常用「几个冬天」来计算年岁。

items.en: The word kept its shape while spelling changed little, and wintry joined it as an adjective.
items.cn: 这个词形式基本未变，拼写改动不大，形容词 wintry 也加入进来。

items.en: Calendars fixed the season to three months, and winter clothes and winter sports grew as its company.
items.cn: 历法把这个季节固定为三个月，冬衣与冬季运动成了它的同伴。

items.en: Modern writing borrowed the season for hard times, as in the winter of a career.
items.cn: 现代写作把这个季节借给艰难时期，如事业之冬。

note.en: The first group holds the other seasons and look-alikes, the second words for cold and for hard periods.
note.cn: 第一组收其他季节与形近词，第二组收表示寒冷与艰难时期的词。

entries.definition: The one who comes first.
Twisting from side to side.
The warmest season, its opposite.
The season just before winter.
A cold feeling in the air or the body.
A thin white coat of ice on surfaces.
A period of falling strength or success.

normalIntro.en: Winter shares its opening with wind and wet, which is exactly the weather it names.
normalIntro.cn: winter 与 wind、wet 开头相同，而那正是它所命名的天气。

normal.en: Wind and wet both begin like winter, and both belong to it.
normal.cn: wind 和 wet 都以 winter 的方式开头，也都属于它。

normal.en: The -ter ending appears in other periods too, such as the word for the end of an age.
normal.cn: 结尾的 -ter 也出现在其他时段词里，比如表示某种终了岁月的词。

normal.en: The middle i is thin and sharp, like cold air.
normal.cn: 中间的 i 又细又尖，像冷空气。

normal.en: Add a y and you get wintry, cold and bare.
normal.cn: 加一个 y 就得到 wintry，寒冷而光秃。

normal.en: Remember the old habit of counting age in winters: twenty winters meant twenty years.
normal.cn: 记得古人用「几个冬天」计岁：二十个冬天就是二十岁。

abstract.en: Breath turning white and disappearing at once.
abstract.cn: 呼出的气变白，随即消失。

abstract.en: A river holding still under a thin hard skin.
abstract.cn: 河流停在一层又薄又硬的皮下面。

abstract.en: Bare branches writing dark lines on grey sky.
abstract.cn: 光秃的枝条在灰天上写出黑色的线。

examples.en: We spent the whole winter in the mountains.
examples.cn: 我们在山里度过了整个冬天。

examples.en: Winter comes early in the north of the country.
examples.cn: 这个国家的北方，冬天来得早。

examples.en: The shop closes early in winter.
examples.cn: 这家店在冬天早早就关门。

dict_mnemonic.text: wind（风）+ wet（湿）合起来的感觉，就是「冬天」。

root: 日耳曼语 season 词根（潮湿、寒冷，与 wet、wind 同源）→ 古英语 winter → winter；同族有 wintry、winterize。

sensesIntro.en: From the cold wet half of the year the word widens to cold weather itself, then becomes a picture for any season of hardship.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从一年中寒冷潮湿的一半，扩展到寒冷天气本身，再变成一切艰难时节的图画。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: bare branches over a river frozen thin.
core.cn: 核心意象：结着薄冰的河面上方那些光秃的枝条。

branches.en: The calendar branch: snow lying on the fields all season.
branches.cn: 历法分支：整个季节田野上都覆着雪。

branches.en: The weather branch: a terrible winter that took the sheep.
branches.cn: 天气分支：夺走羊群的可怕寒冬。

branches.en: The metaphor branch: a company crossing the crisis.
branches.cn: 隐喻分支：公司穿过危机之冬。

branches.en: The bare branch: trees stripped, work stopped.
branches.cn: 萧瑟分支：树被剥光，活也停摆。

branches.en: The hardship branch: cold becomes a name for loss.
branches.cn: 艰难分支：寒冷成了失去的名字。

intro.en: Winter takes the adjective ending -y for wintry and appears inside compounds such as wintertime and midwinter.
intro.cn: winter 能接形容词词尾 -y 变成 wintry，也出现在 wintertime、midwinter 这类复合词里。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Germanic; the Latin entry shows how another language named the same season.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词干属于日耳曼语；拉丁条目展示另一种语言如何命名同一个季节。

items.example: It stands alone as noun, verb and modifier.
items.exampleCN: 它单独充当名词、动词和修饰语。

items.example: The season named twice at once.
items.exampleCN: 季节被同时命名了两次。

items.meaning: a sport played on snow or ice

definition_zh: 明智的；聪明的；有智慧的；（口语）知晓的；以…方式
definition_en: having or showing good judgement built from experience, and in spoken use, knowing about something
core_image: 一个人抬手示意同伴先别急，等对方把话说完才点头回了一句
scene: 朋友刚要发火，他抬手示意先别急，等对方把话讲完才慢慢点头。It was a wise decision to leave before the storm began.
sceneCN: 这里 wise 是「明智的」（第 1 个义项：判断得当、有分寸）；句意为在风暴来临前离开是明智的决定。抬手示意别急的那一下，就是这个词的印象。

pos.zh: 明智的；有智慧的；（口语）知晓的

senses.title: Judging well from experience
senses.definition: able to see what matters and choose the right way, especially because of long experience
senses.definitionCN: 能看清什么要紧并选对做法，尤其因长期经验而如此
senses.example: It was a wise decision to leave before the storm began.
senses.exampleCN: 在风暴来临前离开是明智的决定。
senses.why: The old adjective simply described someone who knows, and knowing how to act came to be the heart of it.
senses.whyCN: 这个古老形容词最初只形容某人知道，后来懂得如何行动成了它的核心。

senses.title: In spoken use: aware of
senses.definition: in informal speech, knowing about something, often something hidden or unpleasant
senses.definitionCN: 在口语中表示知道某事，常指隐藏或不愉快的事
senses.example: She was wise to their tricks and refused to sign.
senses.exampleCN: 她看穿了他们的把戏，拒绝签字。
senses.why: The informal sense keeps the old idea of knowing, but strips away the judgement and leaves mere awareness.
senses.whyCN: 口语义保留了古老「知道」的观念，却剥掉了判断，只剩知晓。

senses.title: As a suffix: in the way of
senses.definition: attached to a noun to mean with regard to that thing, as in money-wise or stepwise
senses.definitionCN: 接在名词后表示就某方面而言或按某种方式，如 money-wise、stepwise
senses.example: Clockwise means turning in the direction of a clock.
senses.exampleCN: clockwise 意为沿钟表指示的方向旋转。
senses.why: A separate suffix -wise came from the same root and means manner, which is why it attaches so freely.
senses.whyCN: 另有一个来自同一词根的后缀 -wise 表示方式，所以它能自由地黏在各种词上。

intro.en: Wise is a Germanic adjective of knowing, Old English wīs, related to the verb that gave wit, and to the noun wisdom.
intro.cn: wise 是日耳曼语中表示「知道」的形容词，古英语 wīs，与产生 wit 的动词同源，也与 wisdom 相关。

items.en: The root meant to see or to know, and the same family gave German wissen, to know.
items.cn: 这个词根意为看见或知道，同族给了德语 wissen（知道）。

items.en: wīs described a person of knowledge and sound counsel, used of rulers and elders.
items.cn: wīs 形容有知识、能给出好建议的人，用于统治者与长者。

items.en: The adjective kept its shape and paired with -dom to name the quality itself.
items.cn: 这个形容词形式未变，与 -dom 结合来命名品质本身。

items.en: The suffix -wise began to mean manner in compound adverbs such as clockwise.
items.cn: 词尾 -wise 开始在 clockwise 这类复合副词中表示方式。

items.en: Spoken English added the lighter sense of simply being aware, as in wise to a trick.
items.cn: 口头英语又添加了仅表示知晓的轻义，如 wise to a trick。

note.en: The first group holds near twins of spelling, the second other adjectives of good judgement.
note.cn: 第一组收拼写相近的词，第二组收其他表示判断良好的形容词。

entries.definition: The noun of the same family.
To go upwards.
A rare spelling variant of wise.
A clever joking remark.
Showing practical good sense.
Careful about the future, avoiding risk.
Showing a lack of sense.

normalIntro.en: Wise is a short word with a long history; link it to wit and wisdom rather than to spelling tricks.
normalIntro.cn: wise 词短史长；把它和 wit、wisdom 连起来，比靠拼写技巧更牢。

normal.en: Wise and wit share a root: both are about knowing.
normal.cn: wise 和 wit 同根：都与「知道」有关。

normal.en: Add dom to get wisdom, the state of being wise.
normal.cn: 加 dom 得到 wisdom，即明智的状态。

normal.en: The past of rise is rose, and rise looks close, but wise needs the z sound.
normal.cn: rise 的过去式是 rose，看起来相近，但 wise 发的是 z 音。

normal.en: Money-wise means where money is concerned: the suffix means with regard to.
normal.cn: money-wise 意为就钱而言：这个后缀表示「就…而言」。

normal.en: A wise choice usually looks boring at the time and obvious years later.
normal.cn: 明智的选择当时看着平淡，多年之后显得理所当然。

abstract.en: A hand raised to slow a friend down.
abstract.cn: 一只抬起的手，让朋友慢一点。

abstract.en: A nod after listening, not during.
abstract.cn: 听完之后的点头，而不是听到一半就点。

abstract.en: A step taken carefully, then a second one.
abstract.cn: 先迈出小心的第一步，再迈第二步。

examples.en: It would be wise to check the figures twice.
examples.cn: 把数字核对两遍是明智的。

examples.en: She gave me some wise advice about saving money.
examples.cn: 她给了我一些关于存钱的明智建议。

examples.en: He is wise to their plan and will not join it.
examples.cn: 他看穿了他们的计划，不会参与。

dict_mnemonic.text: wit（智力）+ -ise 的读音相近 —— 有智力又能用对，就是「明智的」。

root: 日耳曼语词根（看见、知道）→ 古英语 wīs（明智的）→ wise；同族有 wisdom、wisely、wit。

sensesIntro.en: From the deep judgement of the old, the word lightens in speech to mere awareness, and lives on as a suffix meaning in the manner of.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从长者的深厚判断，在口语里变轻为单纯知晓，并作为表示方式的后缀继续存在。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a raised hand that asks for a moment of thought.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只抬起、要求稍作思考的手。

branches.en: The judgement branch: leaving before the storm.
branches.cn: 判断分支：风暴前动身。

branches.en: The awareness branch: wise to a trick.
branches.cn: 知晓分支：看穿一个把戏。

branches.en: The suffix branch: clockwise, money-wise.
branches.cn: 后缀分支：clockwise、money-wise。

branches.en: The lightness branch: knowing without judging.
branches.cn: 轻义分支：知道而不评判。

branches.en: The practical branch: sense turned into a way of doing things.
branches.cn: 务实分支：判断力化为做事的方式。

intro.en: Wise stands alone and also works as a suffix meaning manner; with -dom and -ly it builds the rest of its family.
intro.cn: wise 可以单独使用，也能当表示方式的后缀；配上 -dom 与 -ly 便构成它的其余家族。

latinIntro.en: The adjective is Germanic; the Latin entries give borrowed words for the same virtue.
latinIntro.cn: 这个形容词属于日耳曼语；拉丁条目给出表达同一美德的借入词。

items.example: The adjective turned into an action.
The wit sense pressed into a joke.
items.exampleCN: 机智义被压进一个笑话。

items.example: The ending marks degrees of judgement.

definition_zh: 希望；愿望；想要；祝愿；许愿
definition_en: to want something to happen, especially something you cannot control, and to express that want
core_image: 生日蛋糕上那点烛火面前，一个人闭眼低头，把愿望在心里说了一遍
scene: 蛋糕上的烛光照到脸上，他闭眼低头，把愿望在心里说了一遍才吹熄。I wish you good luck in the exam tomorrow.
sceneCN: 这里 wish 是「希望、祝愿」（第 1 个义项：希望某事发生、尤其是自己无法掌控的事）；句意为祝你明天考试顺利。闭眼低头许愿的那一刻，就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: To want it to be so
senses.definition: to want something to be true or to happen, especially when you cannot make it happen
senses.definitionCN: 希望某事为真或发生，尤其在自己无法使之实现时
senses.example: I wish you good luck in the exam tomorrow.
senses.exampleCN: 祝你明天考试顺利。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply to desire, and the word keeps a soft and slightly helpless colour.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是想，这个词保留着温和而略带无力的色彩。

senses.title: To express a hope for someone
senses.definition: to say that you hope someone will be happy, safe or successful, as in good wishes
senses.definitionCN: 说希望某人幸福、平安或成功，如 good wishes
senses.example: She wished the bride and groom a long and happy life.
senses.exampleCN: 她祝愿新郎新娘百年好合。
senses.why: Desire aimed at another person becomes a blessing, which is why the word greets and closes letters.
senses.whyCN: 指向他人的愿望成了祝福，所以这个词能用来问候与收尾信件。

senses.title: A longing in the mind
senses.definition: a strong desire for something, often secret, kept as a noun
senses.definitionCN: 对某物的强烈想望，常是秘密的，作名词使用
senses.example: The old man's last wish was to see the sea again.
senses.exampleCN: 老人最后的愿望是再见一次海。
senses.why: The noun simply names the desire that the verb performs, often before it is spoken aloud.
senses.whyCN: 名词直接命名动词所做的那份欲望，往往在说出口之前就有。

senses.title: To greet with a formula
senses.definition: used in set phrases such as wish you well, to offer a polite and warm formula
senses.definitionCN: 在 wish you well 等固定说法中，用来致以礼貌而温暖的问候
senses.example: The staff wished every guest good morning at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 员工在门口向每位客人问早安。
senses.why: Greetings in most languages are blessings, so wishing is how many conversations begin.
senses.whyCN: 多数语言里的问候都是祝福，所以祝愿是许多对话的开头。

intro.en: Wish is Old English wyscan, to desire, a native Germanic verb that also gave the noun wish, an inner want.
intro.cn: wish 是古英语 wyscan（渴望），一个本土日耳曼语动词，也产生了名词 wish，指内心的想望。

items.en: wyscan meant to long for, often in prayer, and expressed a hope rather than a plan.
items.cn: wyscan 意为渴望，常用于祈祷，表达的是希望而非计划。

items.en: The verb was strong, and its noun form named the desire itself.
items.cn: 这个动词是强变化动词，其名词形式命名欲望本身。

items.en: Spelling settled as wish, and the meaning widened to polite good wishes.
items.cn: 拼写固定为 wish，词义扩展到礼貌的祝愿。

items.en: I wish plus a past form became a fixed way to speak of an unreal state.
items.cn: I wish 加过去式成了谈论不真实状况的固定说法。

items.en: The birthday wish and the wishing well kept the fairy tale sense alive in daily life.
items.cn: 生日愿望与许愿井让童话式的义项在日常生活中存活下来。

note.en: The first group collects look-alikes with similar spelling, the second verbs of wanting and hoping.
note.cn: 第一组收拼写相近的词，第二组收表示想要与希望的动词。

entries.definition: To clean with water.
An animal that lives in water.
Based on wanting rather than on fact.
The power to think and be clever.
To want something with some expectation.
A strong feeling of wanting.
To feel a strong pull towards something absent.

normalIntro.en: Wish is small and soft, best remembered by the picture of a candle and a closed pair of eyes.
normalIntro.cn: wish 短而柔和，最值得记的是那幅烛光与闭眼画面。

normal.en: Wish and fish differ in one letter: you can wish for a fish.
normal.cn: wish 与 fish 只差一个字母：你可以许愿得到一条鱼。

normal.en: Drop the last letter of wash and add i to get wish.
normal.cn: wash 去掉末字母、换上 i，就得到 wish。

normal.en: The third person is wishes, with -es after the sh sound.
normal.cn: 第三人称是 wishes，在 sh 音后加 -es。

normal.en: I wish I knew is not about the past: it is a wish for now.
normal.cn: I wish I knew 说的不是过去，而是此刻的愿望。

normal.en: Wishful thinking is desire dressed as a plan.
normal.cn: wishful thinking 是披着计划外衣的欲望。

abstract.en: One small flame taking the shape of a breath.
abstract.cn: 一小团火焰被一口气吹成的形状。

abstract.en: Eyes closed while the room waits.
abstract.cn: 闭上的眼睛，满屋的人在等。

abstract.en: A coin falling into a well, and no sound coming back.
abstract.cn: 一枚硬币落进井里，没有声音回来。

examples.en: I wish I could stay longer.
examples.cn: 我希望自己能再多待一会儿。

examples.en: Close your eyes and make a wish.
examples.cn: 闭上眼睛许个愿吧。

examples.en: We wish you a safe journey home.
examples.cn: 祝你平安回家。

dict_mnemonic.text: wish 与 fish 只差首字母 —— 生日时对着一根蜡烛「许愿」。

root: 古英语 wyscan（渴望、祈祷）→ 中古英语 wischen → wish；同族有 wishful、well-wisher。

sensesIntro.en: The word starts as a soft longing, then becomes a blessing for another person, a secret wish kept inside, and finally a polite formula at the door.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从柔和的渴望开始，变成对他人的祝福，再成为藏在心里的愿望，最后成了门口的一句问候。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a candle flame bending in a breath.
core.cn: 核心意象：烛焰被一口气吹弯。

branches.en: The hoping branch: wishing a friend luck in an exam.
branches.cn: 希望分支：祝朋友考试顺利。

branches.en: The blessing branch: wishes for the bride and groom.
branches.cn: 祝福分支：给新郎新娘的祝愿。

branches.en: The longing branch: an old man's last wish.
branches.cn: 渴望分支：老人最后的愿望。

branches.en: The greeting branch: good morning said at the door.
branches.cn: 问候分支：门口的道早。

branches.en: The gap branch: what you wish is often out of reach.
branches.cn: 落差分支：所想望的往往够不到。

intro.en: Wish takes ordinary verb endings and builds a small family: wishful, well-wisher and the wishing well.
intro.cn: wish 能接普通动词词尾，构成一小族词：wishful、well-wisher 和 wishing well。

latinIntro.en: The verb is Germanic; the Latin entries are borrowed words for desire and goodwill.
latinIntro.cn: 这个动词属于日耳曼语；拉丁条目是表示欲望与善意的借入词。

items.example: It is the plain verb and noun.

items.meaning: a well where wishes are made
items.example: The old picture kept in a place.
items.exampleCN: 古老画面藏进一处地方。

items.example: The noun used to close a letter.

definition_zh: 与…一起；用；带着；随着；对…（表示态度）；由于
definition_en: a very common preposition meaning together with, by means of, having, or in relation to
core_image: 两个人的手同时落在一根扁担上，从两头一起把重物抬起来
scene: 两人把扁担搭上肩，一前一后同时起步，步子慢慢就合上了。He came to the meeting with his father and a folder of papers.
sceneCN: 这里 with 是「与…一起」（第 1 个义项：表示伴随、同在）；句意为他带着父亲和一只文件夹来开会。两个人同时握住扁担抬起重物的那一刻，就是这个词的印象。

pos.zh: 与…一起；用；带着；随着；对…；由于

senses.title: In company of
senses.definition: in the company of a person or an object, or carrying something
senses.definitionCN: 与某人或某物同在，或随身带着某物
senses.example: He came to the meeting with his father and a folder of papers.
senses.exampleCN: 他带着父亲和一只文件夹来开会。
senses.why: The oldest use simply puts two things in one place, side by side at the same moment.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的用法只是把两样东西放在同一处、同一时刻并列。

senses.title: By means of a tool
senses.definition: showing the tool, material or method that does a job
senses.definitionCN: 表示完成某事的工具、材料或方法
senses.example: She cut the bread with a long knife.
senses.exampleCN: 她用一把长刀切面包。
senses.why: The thing in your hand is the closest companion of the act, so company became instrument.
senses.whyCN: 手里握着的东西是动作最近的同伴，于是同伴变成了工具。

senses.title: Attitude towards someone
senses.definition: showing how a person feels about someone, as in angry with or pleased with
senses.definitionCN: 表示某人对某人的感受，如 angry with、pleased with
senses.example: The teacher was pleased with the whole class.
senses.exampleCN: 老师对全班都很满意。
senses.why: Feelings are directed at people who are near, so the company sense turned into a sense of attitude.
senses.whyCN: 情感朝向近旁的人，于是相伴义变成了态度义。

senses.title: Changing together with
senses.definition: showing that two things change at the same time, as in with age or with time
senses.definitionCN: 表示两件事同时变化，如 with age、with time
senses.example: The colours of the leaves change with the season.
senses.exampleCN: 叶子的颜色随季节改变。
senses.why: Two events in step are also two things together, so the word covers parallel change.
senses.whyCN: 同步发生的两件事也是同在的两件事，于是这个词也覆盖并行变化。

intro.en: With is Old English wið, which first meant against, towards, or in exchange for, before it settled into together with.
intro.cn: with 是古英语 wið，最初意为对着、朝向或以物易物，后来才固定为「与…一起」。

items.en: A common Germanic preposition named the idea of being opposite or facing something.
items.cn: 一个共同的日耳曼语介词表示相对、面对某物的观念。

items.en: wið meant against, towards or in exchange for, and often marked opposition.
items.cn: wið 意为对着、朝向或以物换物，常标记对立。

items.en: The same word was used of a meeting between two parties, which carried the seed of togetherness.
items.cn: 同一个词也用于两方相遇，其中埋下了「同在」的种子。

items.en: The sense shifted from opposition to company, and wið became with.
items.cn: 词义从对立转向相伴，wið 变成 with。

items.en: The preposition widened to tools, possession, attitude and simultaneous change.
items.cn: 这个介词扩展到工具、拥有、态度与同步变化。

note.en: The first group collects prepositions built from the same stem, the second near synonyms of company and means.
note.cn: 第一组收由同一词干构成的介词，第二组收表示伴随与手段的近义词。

entries.definition: Inside a place or a period.
Not having, not accompanied by.
The power of clever thinking.
The measure from side to side.
Next to and together with.
Near, or by means of.
The negative of with.

normalIntro.en: With is a function word, so learn it as a set of frames rather than a single meaning.
normalIntro.cn: with 是功能词，把它当成一组句式框架来学，比记单一意思更有效。

normal.en: The th sound is soft and voiced, the same as in this and that.
normal.cn: 它的 th 是浊音，与 this、that 相同。

normal.en: With begins with wit minus the t: a preposition with no jokes inside.
normal.cn: with 就是 wit 去掉 t：一个没有玩笑的介词。

normal.en: Add out to make without, the opposite of company.
normal.cn: 加 out 得到 without，是相伴的反面。

normal.en: Add in to make within, the opposite of crossing a boundary.
normal.cn: 加 in 得到 within，是不越界的说法。

normal.en: With is often a tool, a companion, or a mood, so ask which of the three a sentence needs.
normal.cn: with 常表示工具、同伴或情绪，读到句子先问是哪一种。

abstract.en: Two hands on one pole, lifting at the same moment.
abstract.cn: 两只手在同一根扁担上，同时用力。

abstract.en: Two sets of footprints walking in the same line.
abstract.cn: 两串脚印走在同一条线上。

abstract.en: A hand holding a key that fits a lock.
abstract.cn: 一只手握着正好合锁的钥匙。

examples.en: I went to the market with my aunt.
examples.cn: 我和姑妈一起去了市场。

examples.en: He opened the box with a small screwdriver.
examples.cn: 他用一把小螺丝刀打开了盒子。

examples.en: The room grew quiet with the falling snow.
examples.cn: 随着雪落，房间安静下来。

dict_mnemonic.text: with 三张脸：一起、用、带着 —— 同伴、工具、随身的物。

root: 古英语 wið（对着、朝向、交换）→ 中古英语 with（与…一起）；同族有 within、without、withdraw。

sensesIntro.en: The preposition begins as opposition, turns into company, and spreads from people to tools, attitudes and simultaneous change.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个介词从对立开始，转为相伴，再从人扩展到工具、态度与同步变化。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands on one carrying pole, lifted at once.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手在同一根扁担上同时发力。

branches.en: The company branch: arriving with a father and papers.
branches.cn: 相伴分支：带着父亲和文件到场。

branches.en: The tool branch: bread cut by a long knife.
branches.cn: 工具分支：一把长刀切面包。

branches.en: The feeling branch: a teacher pleased with a class.
branches.cn: 情感分支：一个满意的老师。

branches.en: The change branch: leaves turning with the season.
branches.cn: 变化分支：随季节变色的叶子。

branches.en: The nearness branch: what is at hand becomes the means.
branches.cn: 邻近分支：手边之物成了手段。

intro.en: With is a bare preposition that joins other words as a prefix in within, without, withdraw and withhold.
intro.cn: with 是光秃的介词，作为前缀与其他词结合成 within、without、withdraw、withhold。

latinIntro.en: The word is native Germanic, so the Latin entries are borrowed prepositions for the same ideas.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词是本土日耳曼语，所以拉丁条目是表达同类观念的借入介词。

items.example: It appears in withdraw and withhold.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 withdraw 与 withhold 中。

definition_zh: 没有；不带；不用；（后接动名词）不…就；在…之外
definition_en: not having, not using, or not accompanied by something, and in older use, outside of
core_image: 一个人出门时两只手都空着，口袋里什么也没装
scene: 他出门时两手空空，口袋里什么也没带，连钥匙都留在了桌上。We cannot finish the work without more help.
sceneCN: 这里 without 是「没有」（第 1 个义项：不带、缺少某物）；句意为没有更多人手，我们完不成这项工作。两手空着出门的那一刻，就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: Not having something
senses.definition: not having or not carrying something that is usually there
senses.definitionCN: 没有或未携带通常应存在之物
senses.example: We cannot finish the work without more help.
senses.exampleCN: 没有更多人手，我们完不成这项工作。
senses.why: The oldest form meant outside of, and what is outside you is simply not yours to hold.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的形式意为在…之外，而在你之外的东西就不在你手里。

senses.title: Not using something
senses.definition: not using a thing, or not doing something, as in without a key or without asking
senses.definitionCN: 不使用某物，或不做某事，如不用钥匙、不打招呼
senses.example: He opened the lock without a key.
senses.exampleCN: 他没用钥匙就把锁打开了。
senses.why: Doing something without a tool means the tool is outside the act, which is the same picture again.
senses.whyCN: 不使用工具做事，意味着工具在这一动作之外，又是同一幅画面。

senses.title: Not accompanied by
senses.definition: with no one or nothing else present, in phrases such as without a word
senses.definitionCN: 没有其他人在场或没有别的东西相伴，如 without a word
senses.example: She left the room without a word.
senses.exampleCN: 她一句话没说就离开了房间。
senses.why: A companion who is outside the scene is absent, so the preposition also marks silent or lonely action.
senses.whyCN: 不在场景里的同伴就是缺席，所以这个介词也能标记沉默或孤单的行动。

senses.title: Outside of, in older use
senses.definition: in old or literary style, on the outside of a place
senses.definitionCN: 在旧式或文学文体中，指在某地之外
senses.example: Without the city walls lay a wide empty field.
senses.exampleCN: 城墙之外是一片开阔的空地。
senses.why: This is the original sense, still alive in poetry, from which all the others grew.
senses.whyCN: 这是最原始的义项，仍活在诗歌里，其余义项都由它生长出来。

intro.en: Without began as with plus out, meaning outside, and only later slid into the modern sense of not having.
intro.cn: without 起初是 with 加 out，意为在外，后来才滑向现代「没有」的义项。

items.en: wiðutan meant outside, on the outer side of a place or a group.
items.cn: wiðutan 意为在外，处于某地或某群之外。

items.en: Being outside a group meant being denied what the group had.
items.cn: 处在群体之外，就意味着得不到群体拥有的东西。

items.en: The form became without and the lack sense came forward.
items.cn: 形式变作 without，缺少义走到了前面。

items.en: The outside sense narrowed to literary use, and the lack sense took over daily speech.
items.cn: 在外义收窄到文学用法，缺少义占领了日常言语。

items.en: Fixed phrases such as without doubt and without delay made the preposition essential.
items.cn: without doubt、without delay 这类固定短语让这个介词必不可少。

note.en: The first group collects the with family, the second other ways to say a thing is missing.
note.cn: 第一组收 with 家族，第二组收其他表示「缺失」的说法。

entries.definition: Inside a place or a limit.
Accompanied by; having.
To keep something back.
In every part, during the whole time.
Not having a needed thing.
With something taken away.
The word it negates.

normalIntro.en: Without is with plus out, so its oldest picture is simply being out of something, not having it.
normalIntro.cn: without 是 with 加 out，最古老的画面就是身在某物之外，因而没有它。

normal.en: With plus out: to be out of a thing is to be without it.
normal.cn: with 加 out：在东西之外，就是没有它。

normal.en: The th is voiced, as in this; the ending out is clear.
normal.cn: th 是浊音，与 this 相同；结尾的 out 很清楚。

normal.en: The tip is flat on the upper teeth, the same shape as within.
normal.cn: 舌尖平贴上齿，与 within 一样。

normal.en: You cannot do without water: the phrase do without means manage anyway.
normal.cn: cannot do without water 意为离不开水；do without 意为将就着也行。

normal.en: Without doubt and without delay are fixed pairs worth learning as blocks.
normal.cn: without doubt 与 without delay 都是值得整块记下的固定搭配。

abstract.en: Two empty hands turned palm up.
abstract.cn: 两只空空的手，掌心朝上。

abstract.en: A table set for one instead of two.
abstract.cn: 一人份而非两人份的餐具。

abstract.en: A door closing on the sound of footsteps, and then silence.
abstract.cn: 门在脚步声之后关上，然后是安静。

examples.en: She cannot read without her glasses.
examples.cn: 不戴眼镜她看不了书。

examples.en: He agreed without asking what it would cost.
examples.cn: 他还没问要花多少钱就答应了。

examples.en: Without water, the garden would die in a week.
examples.cn: 没有水，这园子一周就会枯掉。

dict_mnemonic.text: with + out —— 东西在范围之外，自然就是「没有」。

root: 古英语 wið + utan（with + out，在外）→ wiðutan → without；反义形式有 with、within。

sensesIntro.en: From being outside a group, the word comes to mean lacking a thing, not using it, not being accompanied by it, and keeps the old sense of outside in poetry.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从身处群体之外，变成缺少某物、不使用某物、无人相伴，并在诗里保留着「在外」的旧义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two empty hands, palms turned up.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只空手，掌心朝上。

branches.en: The lack branch: no extra help to finish the work.
branches.cn: 缺少分支：没有更多人手完成工作。

branches.en: The unused tool branch: a lock opened with no key.
branches.cn: 不用工具分支：不用钥匙打开的锁。

branches.en: The alone branch: leaving the room wordless.
branches.cn: 孤单分支：没说一句话就离开房间。

branches.en: The old branch: fields lying outside the walls.
branches.cn: 旧义分支：城墙外的空地。

branches.en: The negation branch: what is absent shapes what remains.
branches.cn: 否定分支：缺席之物塑造了其余的处境。

intro.en: Without is a fused pair, with plus out, and its mirror word is within.
intro.cn: without 是 with 与 out 熔成的一对，它的镜像词是 within。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Germanic; the Latin entries below are the usual borrowed ways to express lack.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词干属于日耳曼语；下面的拉丁条目是表达缺失的常见借入方式。

items.example: The first half of the compound.
The half that turns the word negative.
items.exampleCN: 让这个词带否定的后半。

items.example: A suffix with the same force.

items.exampleCN: 另一种表达缺席的方式。

items.example: The lack turned into an action.
A fixed block of everyday speech.

definition_zh: 妇女；成年女子；女人（统称）
definition_en: an adult female human being
core_image: 菜市场里拎着两袋菜还能一只手接电话的成年女性身影
scene: 早市的过道上，一位提着两袋菜的中年人边走边和邻居商量孩子上学的事。A woman stopped to help the old man pick up the coins he had dropped.
sceneCN: 这里 woman 是「成年女子」（第 1 个义项：成年的女性人类）；句意为一位女士停下来帮老人捡起掉落的硬币。市场里拎着菜还能一手接电话的成年女性身影，就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 由 woman 加形容词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「有女性气质的；端庄的」
由 woman 加 -hood 构成，义为「女性身份；妇女成年期」
由动词 womanize 加 -er 构成，义为「玩弄女性的人」

senses.title: An adult female person
senses.definition: a fully grown female human being, seen as an individual
senses.definitionCN: 成年的女性人类，作为一个个体来看
senses.example: A woman stopped to help the old man pick up the coins he had dropped.
senses.exampleCN: 一位女士停下来帮老人捡起掉落的硬币。
senses.why: This is the plainest use: the word points at one grown-up female person.
senses.whyCN: 这是最朴素的用法：这个词直接指向一位成年的女性。

senses.title: The female side of us all
senses.definition: the female members of a group or of people in general, taken together
senses.definitionCN: 某个群体或整个人类中的女性成员，合在一起说
senses.example: The hall was full of women waiting for the hiring results.
senses.exampleCN: 大厅里坐满了等待招聘结果的女人。
senses.why: Stressing the first part makes the word work as a general label rather than as a description of one person.
senses.whyCN: 把重音放在前面，这个词就成了一个统称，而不是描述某一个人。

senses.title: The old servant sense
senses.definition: in older English, a female servant or the housekeeper of a household
senses.definitionCN: 在较早的英语中，指女仆或家中管事的女仆
senses.example: In the old household books, the woman was paid each quarter for the washing.
senses.exampleCN: 在旧时的家用账本里，那位女仆每季度领取洗衣的工钱。
senses.why: Because servants were so often women, the bare word could stand for the office itself.
senses.whyCN: 因为仆人多为女性，这个不加修饰的词可以代指那个职务。

intro.en: Woman is Old English wifmann, a compound of wif, meaning female, and mann, meaning person; only later did mann narrow to the male.
intro.cn: woman 来自古英语 wifmann，由 wif（女性）与 mann（人）复合而成；man 后来才缩小为指男性。

items.en: wifmann joined wif, a female, with mann, a human being.
items.cn: wifmann 把表示女性的 wif 与表示人的 mann 结合。

items.en: Like other compounds, it kept the plural wifmenn, with the same vowel change.
items.cn: 与其他复合词一样，它保留了复数 wifmenn，并有同样的元音变化。

items.en: The two parts blended and the first became wo-, giving womman.
items.cn: 两部分融在一起，前一部分变成 wo-，写作 womman。

items.en: The spelling settled as woman with the plural women, keeping the old rounded vowel.
items.cn: 拼写固定为 woman，复数为 women，保留了古老的圆元音。

items.en: Once man came to mean an adult male, the compound was heard as one word, not a phrase.
items.cn: 当 man 转而指成年男性之后，这个复合词就只被当作一个词听，而不是一个短语。

note.en: The first group holds the plural and the words built on the same stem, the second holds other words for a female person.
note.cn: 第一组收复数与同根词，第二组收其他指女性的词。

entries.definition: More than one woman.
Having the qualities thought typical of a woman.
The state of being an adult woman.
A polite word for a woman, now often a little formal.
Of the sex that gives birth, or a person of that sex.
A female child or young person.

normalIntro.en: Woman is an old compound that has worn smooth: wif once meant female and mann once meant person.
normalIntro.cn: woman 是一个被磨旧的古老复合词：wif 原指女性，mann 原指人。

normal.en: The plural women is not spelled with a second o, only the sound changes.
normal.cn: 复数 women 不写第二个 o，变的只是发音。

normal.en: The first part once meant female, so woman says female person from the inside.
normal.cn: 前半部分原意是女性，所以 woman 从字的内部说「女性的人」。

normal.en: Man did not mean adult male at first, which is why woman is not a shortened form of it.
normal.cn: man 最初并不指成年男性，所以 woman 并不是它缩短来的。

normal.en: Womanly adds the adjective ending; womanhood adds the ending for a state.
normal.cn: womanly 加形容词词尾；womanhood 加表示状态的词尾。

normal.en: A woman of her word keeps promises, a phrase that plays on the word word.
normal.cn: a woman of her word 指守信的女人，是拿 word 做的双关。

abstract.en: Two hands holding rice bags and a phone at the same time.
abstract.cn: 两只手同时拎着米袋和手机。

abstract.en: A shoulder turned to carry a child who has fallen asleep.
abstract.cn: 肩膀侧过来，让睡着的孩子靠上。

abstract.en: A voice that ends an argument without raising itself.
abstract.cn: 一个不用提高音量就结束争论的声音。

examples.en: The woman at the desk asked for my name twice.
examples.cn: 柜台后那位女士把我的名字问了两次。

examples.en: More women than men applied for the job this year.
examples.cn: 今年申请这份工作的女性比男性多。

examples.en: She is a woman of her word and always brings the books back on time.
examples.cn: 她说话算话，总是按时把书还回来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「窝闷」——家里忙得窝闷闷转的，多是成年女子。

root: 古英语 wifmann 复合词：wif（女性）+ mann（人），复数 wifmenn；后来 mann 缩小词义，woman 遂成为女性的独立称谓。

sensesIntro.en: The word starts as one grown-up female person, widens into women as a group, and narrows in old texts to the female servant.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从一位成年女性出发，扩展为作为整体的女性，又在旧文本中收窄为女仆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a grown woman carrying bags and a phone at once.
core.cn: 核心意象：同时拎着菜和手机的成年女性。

branches.en: The individual branch: a woman helping an old man.
branches.cn: 个体分支：扶起老人的女士。

branches.en: The group branch: a hall full of waiting women.
branches.cn: 群体分支：满厅等待的女性。

branches.en: The servant branch: the woman paid for the washing.
branches.cn: 仆人分支：领洗衣工钱的女仆。

branches.en: The language branch: woman appears in titles and in fixed polite phrases.
branches.cn: 语言分支：woman 见于头衔与固定客套语。

branches.en: The role branch: a general word that once named a job.
branches.cn: 角色分支：一个统称词曾用作职务名。

intro.en: Woman was once two native words joined, and the second half still carries the old sense of person.
intro.cn: woman 原是两个本土词拼在一起，后半部分至今还带着「人」的旧义。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Germanic and has no Latin ancestor; the Latin words below belong to a different old branch.
latinIntro.cn: 词干属日耳曼语，没有拉丁语祖先；下面的拉丁词属另一支古老的语系。

items.example: The compound has become one word.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词已经融为一体。

items.example: It gives women through an old vowel change.
items.exampleCN: 它通过古老的元音变化得 women。

items.meaning: to make or act in a way
items.meaningCN: 使成为或以某种方式行事

items.example: Its Old English form headed the compound.
items.exampleCN: 它的古英语形式曾是这个复合词的第一部分。

items.meaning: once a person, now an adult male
items.example: The narrowing of this word shaped woman.
items.exampleCN: 这个词义的缩小塑造了 woman。

definition_zh: 想知道；纳闷；感到惊讶；惊奇；奇迹；奇观
definition_en: to want to know something, or to feel surprise and admiration; also the feeling or the thing that causes it
core_image: 夜里抬头看见满天星，脖子一直往后仰，忘了低头
scene: 孩子第一次被带到郊外，抬头看星星看了很久，一句话也不说。I wonder whether the old shop is still open after all these years.
sceneCN: 这里 wonder 是「想知道」（第 1 个义项：心里存着疑问，很想知道答案）；句意为我想知道这么多年过去那家老店是否还开着。夜里仰头看满天星，就是这个词的印象。

pos.zh: 奇迹；奇观；令人惊叹的事物

derivatives.zh: 由 wonder 加 -ful 构成，义为「极好的；精彩的」
由 wonder 加 -ing 构成，义为「好奇的；疑惑的」
由 wonder 加 -ous 构成，义为「奇妙的；令人惊叹的」
由 wonder 加 -ment 构成，义为「惊奇；惊讶之情」

senses.title: To want to know
senses.definition: to feel a wish to know something, often said softly before a polite question
senses.definitionCN: 心里很想弄明白某事，常用在礼貌的提问之前
senses.example: I wonder whether the old shop is still open after all these years.
senses.exampleCN: 我想知道这么多年过去那家老店是否还开着。
senses.why: The old root means to gaze in astonishment, and a mind that keeps gazing turns into a mind that keeps asking.
senses.whyCN: 古老的词根意思是惊讶地凝视，一直望下去的心就变成了不断发问的心。

senses.title: To be struck by something
senses.definition: to feel surprise mixed with admiration when something is greater than expected
senses.definitionCN: 遇到超出预期的事物时，感到惊讶又钦佩
senses.example: The children wondered at the size of the whale in the museum hall.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们望着大厅里那头鲸的骨架，惊讶得说不出话。
senses.why: This is the oldest layer: the body stops and stares because the sight is too large to take in.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的一层：身体停下凝视，因为眼前的景象大得接不住。

senses.title: The feeling itself
senses.definition: the feeling of surprise and admiration that such a sight leaves behind
senses.definitionCN: 那样的景象留下的那份惊讶与钦佩
senses.example: She looked at the night sky with wonder, forgetting the cold.
senses.exampleCN: 她满怀惊奇地望着夜空，忘了冷。
senses.why: Once the staring ends, what remains inside is the feeling, so the name turns into a noun.
senses.whyCN: 凝视结束之后，留在心里的是那种感受，于是这个名字变成了名词。

senses.title: The thing that causes it
senses.definition: a person or thing so extraordinary that it makes people stare and admire
senses.definitionCN: 极其非凡、让人驻足赞叹的人或物
senses.example: The bridge was counted among the wonders of the ancient world.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥被列为古代世界的奇观之一。
senses.why: By a natural shift, the cause of the staring takes the same name as the staring itself.
senses.whyCN: 很自然的一次转移，让引起凝视的东西和凝视本身用了同一个名字。

intro.en: Wonder comes from Old English wundor, a noun for a marvel, related to words for astonishment in the other Germanic languages.
intro.cn: wonder 来自古英语名词 wundor（奇事），与其他日耳曼语中表示惊讶的词同源。

items.en: wundor named a marvel or a portent, something that stopped people in their tracks.
items.cn: wundor 指奇事或征兆，是让人停下脚步的东西。

items.en: Cousin words in the old Germanic languages also mean a marvel, which points to one shared root.
items.cn: 各门古老日耳曼语里的同源词也表示奇事，指向一个共同词根。

items.en: The noun softened to wonder and gained the sense of a feeling as well as a thing.
items.cn: 名词演变为 wonder，既指事物，也开始指一种感受。

items.en: The verb to wonder developed, first meaning to marvel at, then to be curious.
items.cn: 动词兴起来，先表示对某事惊叹，后来表示好奇。

items.en: The polite opener of requests, as in wonder if, became fixed in everyday speech.
items.cn: 作为礼貌开场的 wonder if，在日常口语中固定下来。

note.en: The first group holds the same stem in other shapes, the second holds other words for curiosity and surprise.
note.cn: 第一组收同一词干的其他形态，第二组收其他表示好奇与惊讶的词。

entries.definition: Extremely good or enjoyable.
Feeling curious or puzzled.
Marvellous, amazing, a little literary.
To be filled with wonder, or a wonderful thing.
A strong wish to know or learn something.
A feeling of respect mixed with wonder and fear.

normalIntro.en: Wonder is one stem used as verb and noun: the same word means to stare, to ask, and the thing worth staring at.
normalIntro.cn: wonder 是同一个词干兼作动词和名词：既指凝视，也指发问，还指值得凝视的东西。

normal.en: The noun and the verb share one spelling, so context alone tells you which is meant.
normal.cn: 名词和动词拼写相同，只能靠上下文判断。

normal.en: No wonder is a frozen phrase that still carries the old idea of marvel.
normal.cn: no wonder 是固定说法，仍带着「奇事」的旧意。

normal.en: Add -ful and the marvel becomes an adjective of praise: wonderful.
normal.cn: 加 -ful，奇事就变成赞美的形容词 wonderful。

normal.en: Wonder if is the soft way to ask a question, not a claim of not knowing.
normal.cn: wonder if 是婉转发问的方式，不是在声称不知道。

normal.en: Wonder and wander differ by one letter: one stays still and stares, the other walks away.
normal.cn: wonder 与 wander 只差一个字母：一个驻足凝视，一个走开。

abstract.en: A neck tipped back so far that the sky fills the whole face.
abstract.cn: 脖子仰得太久，整张脸都是天空。

abstract.en: A question that has no sharp edges yet.
abstract.cn: 一个还没有长出尖角的问题。

abstract.en: A hand lifted but not yet touching the stone of the old bridge.
abstract.cn: 手举起来了，却还没碰到老桥的石头。

examples.en: I wonder why she left without saying goodbye.
examples.cn: 我想知道她为什么不告而别。

examples.en: The children stared at the sea in wonder.
examples.cn: 孩子们惊奇地望着大海。

examples.en: It is no wonder that he passed the exam after months of study.
examples.cn: 他苦读了几个月，通过考试一点也不奇怪。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「望的」——一直往前望着的那个东西，就是让人惊奇的「奇迹」。

root: 古英语名词 wundor（奇事、奇迹），与日耳曼语同源词共同指向「惊奇地凝视」这一核心意象；后派生动词义。

sensesIntro.en: From a stopped body the meaning spreads: first to be struck, then to be curious, then to the feeling, and finally to the thing worth staring at.
sensesIntro.cn: 意义从一个停住的身体散开：先是感到震撼，再是好奇，接着是那份感受，最后是值得凝视的事物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a neck tipped back until the sky fills the face.
core.cn: 核心意象：仰头到整张脸都是天空。

branches.en: The asking branch: a soft question about the old shop.
branches.cn: 发问分支：轻声问起那家老店。

branches.en: The staring branch: children lost before a whale skeleton.
branches.cn: 凝视分支：孩子在鲸骨架前出神。

branches.en: The feeling branch: wonder under the night sky.
branches.cn: 感受分支：夜空下的惊奇。

branches.en: The marvel branch: a bridge counted among ancient wonders.
branches.cn: 奇观分支：跻身古代奇迹的桥。

branches.en: The everyday branch: no wonder marks surprise that has become ordinary.
branches.cn: 日常分支：no wonder 标记已经平常的惊讶。

intro.en: Wonder is a plain Germanic stem; the endings it takes, such as -ful and -ous, only colour the marvel into adjectives.
intro.cn: wonder 是朴素的日耳曼语词干；它加上的 -ful、-ous 等词尾，只把这件奇事染成形容词。

latinIntro.en: The stem is native Germanic, so there is no Latin ancestor; the Latin words below are cousins of the same idea only.
latinIntro.cn: 词干是本土日耳曼语，没有拉丁语祖先；下面的拉丁词只是同一想法的表亲。

items.meaning: a marvel, or to stare and ask
items.example: The stem carries both noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干兼作名词与动词。

items.example: The old marvel sense survives here.
items.exampleCN: 古老的奇事义在此保留。

items.example: The participle shows the stopped body.
items.exampleCN: 分词部分呈现停住的身体。

definition_zh: 木材；木头；树林；林地；木（球杆；乐器类别）
definition_en: the hard material of trees used for building, or a small forest; also the hard core of a golf club
core_image: 刚锯开的木头横截面，年轮一圈套一圈，还带着潮气
scene: 院子里新锯断的树桩还没搬走，切面上能数出一圈圈的年轮。The table is made of old oak wood that has turned dark with time.
sceneCN: 这里 wood 是「木材、木头」（第 1 个义项：树木的坚硬材料，用来做东西）；句意为这张桌子是用年久变深的老橡木做的。新锯开的横截面上能数出年轮，就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 由 wood 加 -en 构成，义为「木制的；僵硬的」
由 wood 加 -y 构成，义为「木质化的；树木茂密的」
由 wood 与 land 复合，义为「林地」
由 wood 与 work 复合，义为「木工活；木制部件」

senses.title: The material of a tree
senses.definition: the hard substance inside a tree, cut and used for building or burning
senses.definitionCN: 树干内部的坚硬物质，砍下后用于建造或燃烧
senses.example: The table is made of old oak wood that has turned dark with time.
senses.exampleCN: 这张桌子是用年久变深的老橡木做的。
senses.why: The oldest meaning is the substance itself, the part of the tree that can be carried away and used.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是那种物质本身，也就是树身上能够搬走使用的那部分。

senses.title: A small forest
senses.definition: a piece of land covered with growing trees, smaller than a forest, often in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 一片长着活树的土地，比 forest 小，常用复数
senses.example: We walked through the woods behind the farm until it got dark.
senses.exampleCN: 我们穿过农舍后面的树林，一直走到天黑。
senses.why: Where the material grows in plenty, the same name serves for the place, and the plural marks the many trees.
senses.whyCN: 那种材料长得多的地方也用了同一个名字，复数则点出许多棵树。

senses.title: The hard core of a club
senses.definition: the solid block of a golf club that strikes the ball, once made of wood
senses.definitionCN: 高尔夫球杆击球的那块实心部分，早年用木头制成
senses.example: He hit the ball with the wood instead of the iron on the short hole.
senses.exampleCN: 那洞很短，他用木杆而不是铁杆击球。
senses.why: Because clubs were once carved from hard timber, the material name stuck to the part.
senses.whyCN: 因为球杆早年用硬木削成，材料名就留在了那个部件上。

senses.title: A wooden sound
senses.definition: used to describe a wooden or dull quality, or the section of an orchestra that was once wooden
senses.definitionCN: 用来形容木质的、发闷的特质，也指乐团中过去用木制成的声部
senses.example: The wood section began softly, and the strings came in a beat later.
senses.exampleCN: 木管声部轻轻开始，弦乐晚了一拍进来。
senses.why: Material used as an adjective easily becomes a label for sound or class, not only for substance.
senses.whyCN: 材料名作形容词用，很容易变成声音或类别的标签，而不只是指物质。

intro.en: Wood is Old English wudu, meaning both the tree and its timber, and the same stem survives in the Dutch and German names for wood.
intro.cn: wood 来自古英语 wudu，既指树也指木材，同一词干还见于荷兰语和德语的「木头」。

items.en: wudu named both a growing tree and the timber cut from it.
items.cn: wudu 既指生长着的树，也指砍下的木材。

items.en: Cousin words in Dutch and German still mean wood or forest.
items.cn: 荷兰语与德语的同源词仍表示木头或森林。

items.en: The final vowel weakened, and the form settled toward wode and later wood.
items.cn: 词尾元音弱化，形式向 wode 过渡，最终成为 wood。

items.en: The wooden adjective took the old ending -en, as in golden and silken.
items.cn: 木制的形容词采用了古老的词尾 -en，就像 golden 与 silken。

items.en: The plural woods narrowed mostly to the place sense, the trees standing together.
items.cn: 复数 woods 主要收窄到地方义，即聚在一起的树。

note.en: The first group holds words grown from the same stem, the second holds other words for timber and for small forests.
note.cn: 第一组收同根长出的词，第二组收其他泛指木材与树林的词。

entries.definition: Made of wood; also stiff and unnatural.
Having a lot of wood in it, or full of trees.
Land covered with trees.
Wood prepared for building, often large beams.
Timber cut into rough boards, chiefly American.
A large area thickly covered with trees.

normalIntro.en: Wood is one short native word with a double life: growing trees and the timber cut from them.
normalIntro.cn: wood 是一个简短的本土词，过着双重生活：既指活树，也指砍下来的木头。

normal.en: The plural woods usually means a place full of trees, not several materials.
normal.cn: 复数 woods 通常指满是树的地方，而不是好几种木头。

normal.en: Wooden takes the old ending -en, the same one in golden.
normal.cn: wooden 用古老的词尾 -en，与 golden 相同。

normal.en: Woody adds -y and keeps both letters of the stem: wood plus y.
normal.cn: woody 加 -y 时保留词干的两个字母：wood 加 y。

normal.en: Do not confuse wood with would: one is material, the other a helping verb.
normal.cn: 别把 wood 与 would 混了：一个是材料，一个是助动词。

normal.en: Woodland and woodwork are compounds that join a second common word.
normal.cn: woodland 与 woodwork 都是复合词，后面接一个常用词。

abstract.en: Rings counted on a fresh stump.
abstract.cn: 在新鲜的树桩上数年轮。

abstract.en: A grain that pulls a nail slightly to one side.
abstract.cn: 木纹让钉子微微歪向一边。

abstract.en: Warmth that comes from a wall of old beams.
abstract.cn: 一面旧梁柱墙传来的温度。

examples.en: The old chair is carved from a single block of wood.
examples.cn: 这把旧椅子是用一整块木头雕成的。

examples.en: They gathered dry wood for the fire before nightfall.
examples.cn: 天黑前他们捡好了烧火用的干柴。

examples.en: A path runs through the woods behind the village school.
examples.cn: 一条小路穿过村小学后面的林子。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「屋的」——盖屋子用的，正是木材。

root: 古英语 wudu（树；木材），与荷兰语、德语同源；加 -en 得 wooden，加 -y 得 woody。

sensesIntro.en: The material comes first, then the place where it grows, then the part of an object once cut from it, and finally the dull wooden quality.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是材料，再是长材料的地方，接着是用它削成的部件，最后是发闷的木质质感。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rings counted on a freshly cut stump.
core.cn: 核心意象：在刚锯开的树桩上数年轮。

branches.en: The material branch: a table of old oak wood.
branches.cn: 材料分支：老橡木做的桌子。

branches.en: The place branch: a walk through the woods at dusk.
branches.cn: 地方分支：黄昏穿过林子。

branches.en: The club branch: a wooden head striking the ball.
branches.cn: 球杆分支：木制杆头击球。

branches.en: The sound branch: the wood section of an orchestra.
branches.cn: 声音分支：乐团的木管声部。

branches.en: The quality branch: wood as a word for stiffness and dullness.
branches.cn: 质感分支：wood 用来形容僵硬与发闷。

intro.en: Wood is a bare native stem; the endings -en and -y are what turn the material into adjectives.
intro.cn: wood 是一个不带词缀的本土词干；把材料变成形容词的是 -en 与 -y 两个词尾。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Germanic with no Latin ancestor; the Latin words below name the same material from another branch.
latinIntro.cn: 词干属日耳曼语，没有拉丁语祖先；下面的拉丁词从另一支语系来指同一种材料。

items.meaning: tree material or a small forest

items.exampleCN: 它使 wood 成为 woods。

items.meaning: a task or a made thing
a picture printed from a wood block

definition_zh: 词；单词；话；消息；诺言
definition_en: a single unit of language that has a meaning, or a short remark, news, or a promise
core_image: 一个人张开嘴，一个音节落出来，另一个人的表情立刻变了
scene: 母亲只轻轻说了两个字，站在门口的孩子就放下手里的东西转身回了屋。I did not catch a single word of what he said in the noisy hall.
sceneCN: 这里 word 是「词、说的话」（第 1 个义项：语言中能独立表意的最小单位）；句意是在嘈杂的大厅里我一句也没听清他说的话。一个音节落下、听者表情立刻改变，就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 由 word 加 -y 构成，义为「话多的；冗长的」
由 word 加 -ing 构成，义为「措辞；用词」
由 word 加 -less 构成，义为「无言的；说不出话的」
由 word 与 play 复合，义为「文字游戏；双关」

senses.title: The unit of language
senses.definition: a single unit of speech or writing that carries a meaning of its own
senses.definitionCN: 口语或书面语中能独立承载意义的最小单位
senses.example: I did not catch a single word of what he said in the noisy hall.
senses.exampleCN: 在嘈杂的大厅里，他说的每一句话我都没听清。
senses.why: This is the literal core: one sound or one written group that stands for something.
senses.whyCN: 这是字面的核心：一串声音或一组字母，代表某个东西。

senses.title: Something said
senses.definition: a remark or statement, often a short one, taken as it was spoken
senses.definitionCN: 说出口的话或陈述，常常较短，按原样取用
senses.example: A word from her was enough to quiet the whole room.
senses.exampleCN: 她只说一句话，整个屋子就静了下来。
senses.why: Once a unit of language is spoken, it becomes an act in the world, so the word means the remark itself.
senses.whyCN: 语言单位一旦说出口，就成了世界中的一个动作，于是这个词也就指那句具体的话。

senses.title: News carried by speech
senses.definition: information passed from one person to another, usually in the phrase send word
senses.definitionCN: 从一人传到另一人的消息，常用于 send word 这一说法
senses.example: Word of the flood reached the village before the water did.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水的消息比水先到了村里。
senses.why: Because news travels by speech, the unit of speech came to stand for the news it carries.
senses.whyCN: 因为消息靠言语传递，说话的単位便代表它所承载的消息。

senses.title: A promise
senses.definition: a promise that one gives serious weight to, as in keep one's word
senses.definitionCN: 认真对待的承诺，如 keep one's word
senses.example: He gave his word that the work would be finished by Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 他保证这项活儿周五之前完成。
senses.why: A spoken promise is only words, so the word itself became the deposit for trust.
senses.whyCN: 说出口的承诺只是言语，于是这个词本身成了信任的抵押。

senses.title: The way something is put
senses.definition: the particular choice of words used to express something, as in the wording of a rule
senses.definitionCN: 表达某事时的具体用词选择，如条文的措辞
senses.example: The lawyer asked for a change in the word order of the clause.
senses.exampleCN: 律师要求改一下这一条款的词序。
senses.why: Where the unit of language is arranged and chosen, the word names the arrangement as well.
senses.whyCN: 语言单位被挑选与排列的地方，这个词便也指那种排列。

intro.en: Word is Old English word, shared with German Wort and Dutch woord, and originally meant a spoken utterance before it meant a unit of grammar.
intro.cn: word 来自古英语 word，与德语 Wort、荷兰语 woord 同源，最初指说出口的话语，后来才指语法单位。

items.en: word meant a spoken utterance or a message, not a unit on a page.
items.cn: word 指说出口的话或一条信息，不是纸上的一处单位。

items.en: The same noun appears in the other Germanic languages with the same sense.
items.cn: 同一名词在其他日耳曼语里出现，意思相同。

items.en: Latin verbum was the model for grammar writing, which helped the unit sense grow.
items.cn: 拉丁语 verbum 是语法写作的样板，帮助了「单位」这一义项的生长。

items.en: The spelling took its r after the vowel, and word was fixed in both senses, utterance and unit.
items.cn: 拼写把 r 放在元音之后，word 在「话语」与「单位」两义上固定下来。

items.en: The promise sense hardened in phrases such as keep one's word.
items.cn: 诺言之义在 keep one's word 之类的说法里凝定。

note.en: The first group holds the family of words built on this stem, the second holds other language units and speech terms.
note.cn: 第一组收由这个词干构成的词族，第二组收其他语言单位与言辞词。

entries.definition: More than one word, or remarks in general.
The way something is phrased.
Using too many words.
A word or phrase used for a special purpose.
A group of words that work together.
A complete unit of grammar with a subject and a verb.

normalIntro.en: Word is one syllable of old Germanic shape, and its promise sense lives entirely in phrases.
normalIntro.cn: word 是一个很短的日耳曼语音节，它的「诺言」义完全活在固定说法里。

normal.en: Four letters, one vowel sound: word is not spelled like world, so do not add an l.
normal.cn: 四个字母，一个元音：word 与 world 不同，不要多写一个 l。

normal.en: Word for word means exactly the same words, repeated in order.
normal.cn: word for word 指一字不改、照原样重复。

normal.en: In other words introduces a restatement, not a new idea.
normal.cn: in other words 引出换一种说法，而不是新想法。

normal.en: Keep one's word comes from the old idea that a spoken promise is a deposit.
normal.cn: keep one's word 来自「说出口的承诺就是抵押」的旧观念。

normal.en: Have a word with someone means a short talk, not a dictionary exercise.
normal.cn: have a word with someone 指简短谈一谈，不是查词典。

abstract.en: One syllable dropping into a room and changing every face.
abstract.cn: 一个音节落进屋里，每张脸都变了。

abstract.en: A promise left on the table like a coin.
abstract.cn: 一句诺言像硬币一样留在桌上。

abstract.en: Two small letters that carry a whole day of news.
abstract.cn: 两个小字母带着一整天的消息。

examples.en: I looked up the word in an old dictionary.
examples.cn: 我在一本旧词典里查了这个词。

examples.en: Please send word as soon as you arrive.
examples.cn: 你一到就请捎个信来。

examples.en: She kept her word and came back the next morning.
examples.cn: 她守信，第二天早上真的回来了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「窝的」——话是从心窝的，「词」也是从心里出来的。

root: 古英语 word（话语；言语），与德语 Wort、荷兰语 woord 同源；并非源自拉丁语，语法意义上的「词」在后世受 verbum 影响而加强。

sensesIntro.en: From one unit of language the meaning widens to what is said, then to news carried by speech, then to a promise, and finally to the way things are phrased.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一个语言单位开始，意义扩展到说出的话、靠言语传递的消息、承诺，最后是措辞的方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one syllable dropping into a room.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个音节落进屋里。

branches.en: The unit branch: a word looked up in a dictionary.
branches.cn: 单位分支：在词典里查的词。

branches.en: The remark branch: a word that quiets a room.
branches.cn: 言语分支：一句话让屋子安静。

branches.en: The news branch: word of the flood arriving early.
branches.cn: 消息分支：先到的洪水消息。

branches.en: The promise branch: giving one's word by Friday.
branches.cn: 诺言分支：保证周五前完成。

branches.en: The style branch: from what is said to how it is put.
branches.cn: 文体分支：从说了什么到怎么说的。

intro.en: Word is a bare stem; the endings -y, -ing and -less build its family, and a few compounds widen it further.
intro.cn: word 是裸词干；-y、-ing、-less 造出词族，几个复合词进一步把它拓宽。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Germanic with no Latin ancestor; the Latin words below name the same unit in the grammar tradition.
latinIntro.cn: 词干属日耳曼语，没有拉丁语祖先；下面的拉丁词是语法传统中对同一单位的称呼。

items.meaning: a set of keys for typing
items.example: It shows word forms compounding freely.
items.exampleCN: 可见 word 的词形自由构成复合词。

definition_zh: 工作；劳动；干活；运转；起作用；作品；著作
definition_en: to do a job, to labour, or to function properly; also the job itself or something made by effort
core_image: 一双手反复做同一个动作，桌上的东西一点点成形
scene: 车间的灯早上五点就亮了，老师傅已经站在台前擦过两遍手。My father has worked in the same factory for thirty years.
sceneCN: 这里 work 是「工作、干活」（第 1 个义项：为做事而付出劳动）；句意为我父亲在同一家工厂工作了三十年。一双手反复同一个动作、桌上东西慢慢成形，就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 由 work 加 -er 构成，义为「工人；工作者」
由 work 加 -ing 构成，义为「工作的；运转中的」
由 work 加 -able 构成，义为「可行的；可运转的」
由 work 与 -aholic 拼合，义为「工作狂」

senses.title: To do a job
senses.definition: to spend effort on a task, especially in a job that earns money
senses.definitionCN: 为完成某项任务付出力气，尤指挣钱的工作
senses.example: My father has worked in the same factory for thirty years.
senses.exampleCN: 我父亲在同一家工厂工作了三十年。
senses.why: The oldest sense is effort put into something, whether paid or not.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是投入到某事上的力气，不论有没有报酬。

senses.title: To function well
senses.definition: to move or operate correctly, as a machine or a plan does
senses.definitionCN: 像机器或方案那样正确地运行
senses.example: The old radio still works if you turn the dial slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 慢慢转旋钮的话，那台旧收音机还能响。
senses.why: When effort succeeds, the thing made by it keeps going, so the word also means to run properly.
senses.whyCN: 力气奏效之后，被做出来的东西能持续运行，于是这个词也表示正常运转。

senses.title: The job itself
senses.definition: the activity or the post by which money is earned
senses.definitionCN: 用来挣钱的活动或职位
senses.example: She takes her work home with her almost every evening.
senses.exampleCN: 她几乎每天晚上都把工作带回家。
senses.why: Here the noun stops naming the effort and names the post that keeps asking for it.
senses.whyCN: 这里名词不再指那份力气，而指不断要你去付出力气的那个职位。

senses.title: The thing made
senses.definition: a book, painting or other thing produced by effort and skill
senses.definitionCN: 靠努力与技巧做出的书、画或其他东西
senses.example: The painting is said to be the work of a young student.
senses.exampleCN: 据说这幅画是一位年轻学生的作品。
senses.why: The noun turns from the effort to whatever the effort leaves behind.
senses.whyCN: 名词从付出的力气，转到力气留下的东西。

senses.title: To have an effect
senses.definition: to produce the effect that is wanted, as a medicine or a method does
senses.definitionCN: 产生预期的效果，如药物或方法
senses.example: The medicine worked better than the doctor had expected.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药的效力比大夫预想的还好。
senses.why: An effect that follows effort is the same idea as a machine running: something happens because of it.
senses.whyCN: 付出之后产生的效果，与机器运转是同一个想法：因为有了它，事情就发生了。

intro.en: Work is Old English weorc, meaning deed or labour, shared with German Werk and Greek ergon in the wider family.
intro.cn: work 来自古英语 weorc，意即行为或劳作，与德语 Werk 同源，更远可及希腊语 ergon。

items.en: weorc meant a deed and also the effort behind it.
items.cn: weorc 指一件作为，也指背后的付出。

items.en: The same noun and verb appear across the Germanic languages.
items.cn: 同一名词与动词出现在各门日耳曼语中。

items.en: Norse forms such as verk reinforced the word in the north of England.
items.cn: verk 等北欧形式在英格兰北部强化了这个词。

items.en: The verb and the noun shared one spelling, which they still do.
items.cn: 动词与名词共用一个拼法，至今如此。

items.en: The result sense gave works, a word for books, music and pictures.
items.cn: 结果义造出 works，用来指书籍、音乐与绘画。

note.en: The first group holds the large family grown from this stem, the second holds other words for labour and for a produced thing.
note.cn: 第一组收由这个词干长出的庞大家族，第二组收其他表示劳动与成品的词。

entries.definition: A person who works, especially in a job.
Relating to work, or to a machine in use.
Possible to put into practice.
Physical work, often hard; British spelling.
A paid position or a particular task.
A piece of work that has to be done.

normalIntro.en: Work is one stem used as noun and verb, and its family grows with -er, -ing and -able.
normalIntro.cn: work 是同一个词干兼作名词与动词，词族靠 -er、-ing、-able 生长。

normal.en: Work is spelled with or, unlike walk, which has al.
normal.cn: work 中间是 or，而 walk 中间是 al。

normal.en: The noun and verb look the same; only the position in the sentence tells them apart.
normal.cn: 名词与动词写法相同，只能靠位置区分。

normal.en: Worker adds -er for a person, working adds -ing for a state.
normal.cn: worker 加 -er 指人，working 加 -ing 表状态。

normal.en: Work out has three senses: to calculate, to solve, and to exercise.
normal.cn: work out 有三义：算出、解决、锻炼。

normal.en: Works means a set of creations, as in the works of a poet.
normal.cn: works 指一系列创作，如某位诗人的作品。

abstract.en: A pair of hands repeating one motion until a shape appears.
abstract.cn: 一双手重复同一个动作，直到形状出现。

abstract.en: A lamp that stays on hours before anyone else comes in.
abstract.cn: 比谁都早亮的灯。

abstract.en: A radio dial turned very slowly to bring a voice back.
abstract.cn: 旋钮慢慢转，把声音找回来。

examples.en: She works in a small office near the station.
examples.cn: 她在车站附近一间小办公室工作。

examples.en: The plan will work only if everyone agrees.
examples.cn: 只有大家同意，这个方案才会奏效。

examples.en: This painting is the work of a young student.
examples.cn: 这幅画是一位年轻学生的作品。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「我克」——工作就是要一关一关地克过去。

root: 古英语 weorc（作为；劳作），与德语 Werk 同源，更远与希腊语 ergon（工作）同属一个古代词根体系。

sensesIntro.en: The effort comes first, then the job that pays, then running properly, then the thing produced, and finally the effect it has.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是付出的力气，再是挣钱的工作，接着是正常运转，然后是产出的东西，最后是它带来的效果。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands repeating one motion until a shape appears.
core.cn: 核心意象：双手重复动作直到成形。

branches.en: The labour branch: thirty years in one factory.
branches.cn: 劳动分支：在一家厂干三十年。

branches.en: The machine branch: an old radio that still plays.
branches.cn: 机器分支：还能响的旧收音机。

branches.en: The career branch: taking the work home each night.
branches.cn: 职业分支：每晚把工作带回家。

branches.en: The creation branch: a painting by a student.
branches.cn: 创作分支：学生的画。

branches.en: The effect branch: something works because it changes an outcome.
branches.cn: 效果分支：起作用是因为改变了结果。

intro.en: Work is a bare stem with a very productive family: -er, -ing, -able and many compounds.
intro.cn: work 是裸词干，词族极其高产：-er、-ing、-able 以及大量复合词。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Germanic; the Latin words below belong to the same ancient labour family through a different branch.
latinIntro.cn: 词干属日耳曼语；下面的拉丁词经由另一支，同属古老「劳作」语族。

items.meaning: a room for making or teaching

definition_zh: 世界；地球；世人；领域；……界；世道
definition_en: the earth and everything on it, all people, or a particular area of activity and interest
core_image: 从很远处看下来，一整片陆地上灯火连成一条线
scene: 地图铺在桌上，孩子的指尖从一个国家滑到另一个国家，最后停在海边。He travelled the world before he settled down in a small town.
sceneCN: 这里 world 是「世界」（第 1 个义项：地球及其上的一切）；句意为他在一个小镇安顿下来之前走遍了世界。从远处看下去、灯火连成一线的大片陆地，就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 由 world 加 -ly 构成，义为「尘世的；世俗的」
由 world 与 wide 复合，义为「全世界的」
由 world 与 view 复合，义为「世界观」
由 new 与 world 复合，义为「新大陆的」

senses.title: The earth and all on it
senses.definition: the earth together with its people, animals and places
senses.definitionCN: 地球及其上的人、动物与地方
senses.example: He travelled the world before he settled down in a small town.
senses.exampleCN: 他在小镇安顿下来之前走遍了世界。
senses.why: The old compound meant the age of man, and from there it came to name the whole place where people live.
senses.whyCN: 这个古老的复合词原意是「人的世代」，由此转而指人生活的整个场所。

senses.title: Everyone alive
senses.definition: all the people of the earth taken together
senses.definitionCN: 地球上全体的人合起来
senses.example: She told the world about the problem and the letters poured in.
senses.exampleCN: 她把这个问题说给了世人，信件便如潮水般涌来。
senses.why: The place here is not land but people, so the word stands for everyone alive at once.
senses.whyCN: 这里的场所不是土地而是人，于是这个词一下子指所有在世的人。

senses.title: The area of a subject
senses.definition: a particular field of work or interest with its own rules and people
senses.definitionCN: 有一定规则、人物与关注点的特定领域
senses.example: He is well known in the world of science.
senses.exampleCN: 他在科学界很有名。
senses.why: A wide place shrinks to one enclosed circle of people who share a trade, and the same word serves.
senses.whyCN: 一片广阔地方缩小成同行相聚的一个圈子，用的还是同一个词。

senses.title: The way things are
senses.definition: the circumstances of human life, often with a tone of experience or complaint
senses.definitionCN: 人生活的境况，常带阅历或无奈的口吻
senses.example: They have seen enough of the world to know what to expect.
senses.exampleCN: 他们见过的世事足够多，知道该期待什么。
senses.why: When the place sense is used figuratively, it names the span of human affairs rather than a location.
senses.whyCN: 当「场所」义被比喻使用时，它指人间事务的跨度，而不是一个地点。

intro.en: World comes from Old English weorold, a compound of wer, man, and eld, age, so its first sense was the age of man.
intro.cn: world 来自古英语 weorold，由 wer（人）与 eld（世代）复合，最初的意思是「人的世代」。

items.en: weorold meant the age or course of human life, then the whole setting of it.
items.cn: weorold 指人的世代或人生历程，后来指其整个环境。

items.en: The parts wer, man, and eld, age, are Germanic and still visible in werewolf.
items.cn: wer（人）与 eld（世代）属日耳曼语，在 werewolf 中仍可见其痕迹。

items.en: The two parts fused, the r moved, and the word settled toward world.
items.cn: 两部分融合，r 的位置移动，词形固定为 world。

items.en: The place sense widened while the man sense faded from memory.
items.cn: 「场所」义扩大，而「人」的意思从记忆中淡去。

items.en: The field-of-interest sense arose in phrases such as the world of art.
items.cn: 「领域」义兴起于 the world of art 之类的说法。

note.en: The first group holds compounds and derivatives built on this stem, the second holds other words for the planet and for spheres of activity.
note.cn: 第一组收由这个词干构成的复合词与派生词，第二组收其他指星球与活动圈子的词。

entries.definition: Concerned with ordinary life, not with the spirit.
Found or happening all over the earth.
A person's basic view of life.
The planet we live on.
The earth as a round body, or a model of it.
An area of activity or knowledge.

normalIntro.en: World is an old compound that fused into one word, and it has an l that word does not have.
normalIntro.cn: world 是一个融合成一词的古老复合词，它比 word 多一个 l。

normal.en: World has an l before the d; word does not, so check the spelling.
normal.cn: world 在 d 前有一个 l，word 没有，注意拼写。

normal.en: It once said the age of man, which is why it means the whole setting of life.
normal.cn: 它原指人的世代，所以指整个生活的场景。

normal.en: Worldly adds -ly for the earthly side, in contrast to the spiritual.
normal.cn: worldly 加 -ly 指尘世的一面，与精神相对。

normal.en: Worldwide joins wide, so the two ends of the earth are both included.
normal.cn: worldwide 与 wide 结合，把大地两端都包含在内。

normal.en: A world of difference means a huge contrast, not a geography lesson.
normal.cn: a world of difference 指巨大差别，不是地理课。

abstract.en: Lights joined into one line seen from very high up.
abstract.cn: 从极高处看，灯火连成一线。

abstract.en: A finger sliding across a map and stopping at the sea.
abstract.cn: 手指在地图上滑过，停在海边。

abstract.en: A room that holds only one subject but feels complete.
abstract.cn: 只装一个主题却像完整的房间。

examples.en: People all over the world watched the game.
examples.cn: 全世界的人都在看那场比赛。

examples.en: It made a world of difference to have someone to talk to.
examples.cn: 有个人能说说话，情况就大不一样。

examples.en: She is a rising name in the world of design.
examples.cn: 她是设计界冉冉升起的一个名字。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「我的」——整个世界，归根到底是「我的」脚下这一块。

root: 古英语 weorold = wer（人）+ eld（世代），原义「人的世代」，后指人生活的整个世界；与 werewolf 的 were 同源。

sensesIntro.en: The age of man comes first, then the whole earth, then all people, then a single field, and finally the way life goes.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是人的世代，再是整片大地，接着是所有人，然后是一个领域，最后是生活的样子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: lights joined into one line seen from far above.
core.cn: 核心意象：从高处看灯火连成一线。

branches.en: The earth branch: travelling the world before settling down.
branches.cn: 大地分支：安顿前走遍世界。

branches.en: The people branch: telling the world about a problem.
branches.cn: 人分支：把问题说给世人。

branches.en: The field branch: a name in the world of design.
branches.cn: 领域分支：设计界的名字。

branches.en: The experience branch: seeing enough of the world to expect trouble.
branches.cn: 阅历分支：见够了世事知道会有难处。

branches.en: The scale branch: from the planet to a small circle of experts.
branches.cn: 尺度分支：从星球到一小圈专家。

intro.en: World is an old fused compound; -ly and -wide are the endings its derivatives use.
intro.cn: world 是一个古老融合的复合词；它的派生词用 -ly 与 -wide 等词尾。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Germanic, not Latin; the words below name the same planet from another tradition.
latinIntro.cn: 词干属日耳曼语，不是拉丁语；下面的词从另一传统来指同一颗星球。

items.example: The whole compound as one word.
It gives worlds, as in other worlds.

definition_zh: 担心；担忧；使担心；焦虑；烦恼
definition_en: to feel anxious about something, to make someone anxious, or the feeling of anxiety itself
core_image: 半夜翻来覆去，同一件事在脑子里绕圈，越绕越紧
scene: 离考试还有三天，她已经把同一页笔记看了五遍，却什么也没记住。Do not worry; the letter will arrive in a day or two.
sceneCN: 这里 worry 是「担心」（第 1 个义项：对未定之事感到不安）；句意为别担心，信一两天就到。半夜翻来覆去、同一件事在脑子里绕圈，就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 由 worry 加 -ed 构成，义为「担心的；焦虑的」
由 worry 加 -ing 构成，义为「令人担忧的」
由 worrying 加 -ly 构成，义为「令人担忧地」
由 worry 与 wart 拼合，义为「爱操心的人」

senses.title: To feel anxious
senses.definition: to keep turning over something uncertain or unpleasant in the mind
senses.definitionCN: 心里反复想着未定或不好的事
senses.example: Do not worry; the letter will arrive in a day or two.
senses.exampleCN: 别担心，信一两天就到。
senses.why: The oldest meaning is to strangle, and the mind does to a thought what a hand does to a throat.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是勒住，而心对念头做的事，正如手对喉咙做的事。

senses.title: To make someone anxious
senses.definition: to cause another person to feel uneasy by what one does
senses.definitionCN: 因自己的行为让别人感到不安
senses.example: It worries me that she has not called since Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 她周五之后就没来电话，这让我不安。
senses.why: The same grip is now given to another person, so the verb moves from feeling it to causing it.
senses.whyCN: 同一只手现在攥住的是别人，于是动词从「被攥」变为「去攥」。

senses.title: The feeling
senses.definition: the state of being anxious, or a particular thing that causes it
senses.definitionCN: 焦虑的状态，或引起它的一件件具体事
senses.example: Money is the biggest worry for most families this year.
senses.exampleCN: 今年大多数家庭最大的烦恼就是钱。
senses.why: The verb turns into a noun that names both the state and the things that keep it going.
senses.whyCN: 动词转成名词，既指那种状态，也指不断维持它的那些事。

senses.title: To keep biting at something
senses.definition: of an animal, to bite and shake something again and again
senses.definitionCN: 指动物反复咬住并甩动某物
senses.example: The dog worried the old shoe until the sole came off.
senses.exampleCN: 那只狗把那旧鞋咬来甩去，直到鞋底脱落。
senses.why: This is the oldest visible sense: the throat, the bite, the grip that does not let go.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的可见义：喉咙、咬住、不放的那只手。

intro.en: Worry came from Old English wyrgan, to strangle, and only in modern English did it come to mean mental distress.
intro.cn: worry 来自古英语 wyrgan（勒死），到近代英语才用于表示心里的忧苦。

items.en: wyrgan meant to strangle or to seize by the throat.
items.cn: wyrgan 意为勒死或扼住喉咙。

items.en: The stem appears in other Germanic words for choking and wrestling.
items.cn: 同一词干出现在其他日耳曼语中表示窒息与扭打的词里。

items.en: The meaning moved to seizing and shaking with the teeth, as a dog worries a bone.
items.cn: 词义转向用牙齿咬住甩动，如狗折腾骨头。

items.en: In the nineteenth century the sense spread to the mind: to worry a problem.
items.cn: 十九世纪这层意思扩展到内心：把一个问题反复「咬住」。

items.en: The anxious sense became the main one, and the earlier bite sense survives in descriptions of animals.
items.cn: 忧虑义成了主要义项，早先的咬义仅存于描述动物的文字中。

note.en: The first group holds the forms of the same verb, the second holds other words for anxiety.
note.cn: 第一组收同一动词的各种形态，第二组收其他表示焦虑的词。

entries.definition: Feeling anxious.
Causing anxiety.
Third person singular, or more than one worry.
A feeling of worry about someone or something.
A stronger, often lasting feeling of worry.
To worry in a small, restless way.

normalIntro.en: Worry keeps the stem and changes y to i before endings: worries, worried.
normalIntro.cn: worry 保留词干，在加词尾时把 y 变成 i：worries、worried。

normal.en: After a consonant plus y, the y turns to i before -es and -ed: worried.
normal.cn: 辅音加 y 结尾，接 -es、-ed 时 y 变 i：worried。

normal.en: The present participle adds -ing without a change: worrying.
normal.cn: 现在分词直接加 -ing：worrying。

normal.en: Worry about takes the thing that troubles you, worry over is a more literary variant.
normal.cn: worry about 后接让你发愁的事，worry over 更书面。

normal.en: The verb can take a person as object: it worries me, meaning it makes me anxious.
normal.cn: 这个动词也可以接人作宾语：it worries me，意思是他让我担心。

normal.en: Its old meaning is to strangle, which explains why worry feels like a grip on the chest.
normal.cn: 它的古义是勒住，这解释了担心为何像胸口被攥住。

abstract.en: A thought circling the same night hour after hour.
abstract.cn: 一个念头一夜又一夜地绕圈。

abstract.en: A hand closing, though there is nothing in it.
abstract.cn: 手握紧了，里面却空着。

abstract.en: A page read five times without a single word staying.
abstract.cn: 一页看了五遍，一个字也没留下。

examples.en: Try not to worry about the results.
examples.cn: 尽量别为结果担心。

examples.en: His silence worried everyone at the table.
examples.cn: 他的沉默让桌边所有人都担心起来。

examples.en: Her main worry was how to pay the rent.
examples.cn: 她最大的烦恼是怎么付房租。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「我瑞」——心里总觉着不祥的「瑞」兆要出事，于是担心。

root: 古英语 wyrgan（勒死、扼住），中古英语转为「咬住甩动」，近代英语才引申为「心里反复咬住一件事」，即担心。

sensesIntro.en: The throat grip comes first, then the bite that shakes, then the anxious mind, then the anxiety passed to others, and finally the anxiety itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是扼喉，再是咬住甩动，接着是焦灼的心，然后是把焦虑传给别人，最后是焦虑本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thought circling deeper hour after hour.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个念头越绕越紧。

branches.en: The anxiety branch: a letter that will surely arrive.
branches.cn: 焦虑分支：信总会到的。

branches.en: The causing branch: silence that makes others uneasy.
branches.cn: 致忧分支：让旁人不安的沉默。

branches.en: The noun branch: rent as the biggest worry.
branches.cn: 名词分支：最大的烦恼是房租。

branches.en: The bite branch: a dog shaking an old shoe.
branches.cn: 咬分支：狗甩旧鞋。

branches.en: The everyday branch: the same word for the feeling and the cause.
branches.cn: 日常分支：感受与来源共用一词。

intro.en: Worry is a bare stem whose y changes to i before endings, and -ing and -ed build its adjectives.
intro.cn: worry 是裸词干，加词尾时 y 变 i，-ing 与 -ed 构成它的形容词。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Germanic; the Latin words below name a close feeling from another tradition.
latinIntro.cn: 词干属日耳曼语；下面的拉丁词从另一传统来指相近的感受。

items.exampleCN: 它解释了 worried 的写法。

definition_zh: 价值；值……钱；值得；有用；财产
definition_en: the value of something in money or in importance, or deserving of something
core_image: 秤盘上放一件旧东西，指针停在一个谁都说不上来的刻度
scene: 旧货摊上，摊主看了看那只表，摇了摇头说这表不值几个钱，但时间准得让人舍不得扔。The old bicycle is not worth much, but I would not sell it for anything.
sceneCN: 这里 worth 是「价值、值（多少钱）」（第 1 个义项：事物在金钱或重要性上可衡量的价值）；句意为这辆旧自行车不值多少钱，但我多少钱也不卖。秤盘上那件东西停在一个不好说的刻度上，就是这个词的印象。

collocations.zh: 不管有没有用；仅供参考

derivatives.zh: 由 worth 加 -y 构成，义为「值得的；可敬的」
由 worth 加 -less 构成，义为「无价值的；没用的」
由 worth 与 while 复合，义为「值得花时间的」
由 worthy 加 -ness 构成，义为「值得；可贵」

senses.title: Value in money
senses.definition: the amount of money that something would bring if sold
senses.definitionCN: 某物出售时能得到的钱数
senses.example: The old bicycle is not worth much, but I would not sell it for anything.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆旧自行车不值多少钱，但我多少钱也不卖。
senses.why: The core meaning is measured value: how much a thing is worth on a scale of money.
senses.whyCN: 核心意思是可衡量的价值：一件东西在钱的刻度上值多少。

senses.title: Deserving of something
senses.definition: having enough value or merit to justify the cost, effort or time
senses.definitionCN: 有价值到足以抵得上所付出的钱、力或时间
senses.example: This book is worth reading twice.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书值得读两遍。
senses.why: Once value is measured against effort, the word turns into a judgement: is the cost repaid?
senses.whyCN: 一旦把价值与付出相比，这个词就变成一种判断：所付是否值得。

senses.title: The quality that matters
senses.definition: the real importance or usefulness of a person or thing, apart from money
senses.definitionCN: 人或物在金钱之外的真实重要性或用处
senses.example: He proved his worth in the first month of the job.
senses.exampleCN: 他在工作的第一个月就证明了自己的价值。
senses.why: Once the scale is not money but usefulness, the same noun measures a person instead of a thing.
senses.whyCN: 当刻度不是钱而是用处时，同一个名词衡量的就从物变成了人。

senses.title: What one owns
senses.definition: the total of a person's money and property, as in net worth
senses.definitionCN: 一个人的钱财与产业总额，如 net worth
senses.example: The fire took everything of worth in the house.
senses.exampleCN: 那场火烧掉了屋里所有值钱的东西。
senses.why: The noun can also gather all the valuable things together, so it names a body of property.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词也能把值钱的东西收拢在一起，于是指一整套财产。

intro.en: Worth is Old English weorth, meaning value or price, related to the verb weorthan, to become.
intro.cn: worth 来自古英语 weorth，意为价值或价格，与动词 weorthan（成为）相关。

items.en: weorth named the value of a thing, what it was reckoned at.
items.cn: weorth 指一物的价值，即它被估作多少。

items.en: Cousin words in German and Dutch still mean worth or value.
items.cn: 德语与荷兰语的同源词仍表示价值。

items.en: worth was used with a following noun of price, as worth ten pounds.
items.cn: worth 后面常接表示价钱的名词，如 worth ten pounds。

items.en: The adjective use without a verb grew fixed, as in worth a try.
items.cn: 不带系动词的形容词用法固定下来，如 worth a try。

items.en: The suffix -ship built worship from it, and -y built worthy.
items.cn: 后缀 -ship 由它造出 worship，-y 造出 worthy。
